verified_contract: The caller's tenant must own a role=render video/mp4 asset.
Stored byte length and SHA-256 must match non-empty structurally bounded MP4 bytes containing ftyp and media boxes.
A server-side probe must describe the same bytes and provide bounded container, video/audio codec, dimensions, duration, frame rate and audio sample rate.
Every requested destination requires a matching date-stamped dynamic account capability record.
Per-platform account eligibility, bytes, duration, codecs, resolution, frame rate, aspect ratio, privacy and hashtag limits produce actionable blockers.
Title or copy overflow produces adaptation_required with an explicit proposed value and never mutates the source metadata.
Missing, malformed, contradictory or unsupported destination capabilities fail before any upload.
boundary: This milestone validates caller-supplied server probe and capability evidence. It does not implement ffprobe process execution, platform capability retrieval, transcoding, upload or publication.
